emails.subject: Welcome to Aurora Labs — onboarding checklist
emails.body_plain:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Aurora Labs! Your first day is Monday. Here's your onboarding checklist:

- Pick up your laptop from reception (8:30 AM)
- Complete I-9 forms via Rippling (link sent separately)
- Read the engineering handbook (in Notion)
- Lunch with the team at noon

Your buddy is Daniel Kim. He'll DM you on Slack Monday morning.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Priya — People Ops
